The records have a combined expenditure of approximately ₹31.8 Lakh and may represent portions of a larger scope. Their physical boundaries, quantities, locations, and implementing arrangements should be verified. Verify whether these records represent separate physical scopes or portions of one project. If the scope is shared, the file should explain the separate records, quantities, locations, and implementing arrangements.

The sanctioned amount is below the normal Rs. 2.5 lakh minimum. The sanction letter should record why the lower amount benefits the public at large.
